name: HoneyDB API
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator, public API documentation and terms, more than two years of public track record (A8 community; P147 chair: tier community).

reliability.justification: Sightings of a community honeypot network; it also relays third-party lists, which never count as HoneyDB votes.

honeydb_api_id.description: HoneyDB API id (sent in the X-HoneyDb-ApiId header together with honeydb_api_key)
honeydb_api_id.plan_hint: the community tier is non-commercial; record 'business' only for a commercial HoneyDB plan

honeydb_api_key.description: HoneyDB API key (sent in the X-HoneyDb-ApiKey header together with honeydb_api_id)
honeydb_api_key.plan_hint: the community tier is non-commercial; record 'business' only for a commercial HoneyDB plan

api.title: HoneyDB API (GET /api/ip/{ip}: network info, threat info, internet_scanner, ip_history, cve)

terms.quote: P147 cond 1 (binding council text): HoneyDB (free for research/defensive use: key-terms, company key) as a separate adapter with its own status.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P147 cond 1). Research C0355: no key -> 401 'Invalid API Credentials'; the old /api/netinfo/lookup answers 410 endpoint_deprecated (removed 2026-09-28): the client follows the current API documentation (Postman collection, GET /api/ip/{ip} with headers X-HoneyDb-ApiId / X-HoneyDb-ApiKey). The current documentation reads 'free access to the API for non-commercial purposes' for the community tier: business use only with key_plans.honeydb_api_key = business. threat_info.threat_lists are relays of other feeds: display only, never a vote (P171). Used by honeypot_intel.
api.licensed_alternative: A HoneyDB commercial plan recorded as key_plans.honeydb_api_key = business.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P147). One credential in two parts (API id + API key, both required by the API): two key names of one provider, never a second account. No quota block: the free account's monthly quota is shown only on the dashboard (not recorded); a quota answer is 'could not verify'.
